# MERV JavaScript client packages

Three npm packages share one report/server core:

| Package | npm name | Role |
|---------|----------|------|
| [`merv-client-js/`](../) | `merv-client` | Core: local reports, server sync, shared steps, Chai |
| [`merv-client-playwright/`](../../merv-client-playwright/) | `merv-client-playwright` | Playwright Test reporter + wrappers + Cucumber page actions |
| [`merv-client-cucumber/`](../../merv-client-cucumber/) | `merv-client-cucumber` | Cucumber-js formatter + `MervReporter` |

- **[DOCTOR.md](./DOCTOR.md)** — automated `doctor setup` (core / Playwright / Cucumber)
- **[merv-client-playwright README](../../merv-client-playwright/README.md)** — full Playwright setup (reporter-only, wrapped test, Option A bridge, screenshots, Cucumber UI actions)

## Consumer installs

```bash
# Custom / hand-built report (MervReport) — JS or TS
npm i -D merv-client
npx merv-client doctor setup          # automated (optional)
# or follow CUSTOM_REPORT.md manual steps

# View local dashboard (built-in server on :6174)
npx merv show-report

# Playwright Test
npm i -D merv-client merv-client-playwright @playwright/test
npx merv-client-playwright doctor setup

# Cucumber only
npm i -D merv-client merv-client-cucumber @cucumber/cucumber
npx merv-client-cucumber doctor setup

# Cucumber + Playwright UI (formatter + action capture)
npm i -D merv-client merv-client-cucumber merv-client-playwright @cucumber/cucumber playwright
```

## Maintainer build order

```bash
# 1) Core
cd merv-client-js && npm install && npm run build:core

# 2) Framework adapters
cd ../merv-client-playwright && npm install && npm run build
cd ../merv-client-cucumber && npm install && npm run build

# 3) Backward-compat re-exports on core
cd ../merv-client-js && npm install && npm run build:compat
# or: npm run build   # core + compat
```

Legacy subpaths on `merv-client` (`/playwright-reporter`, `/playwright-test`, `/cucumber-formatter`, `/chai`) still re-export the split packages when those packages are installed.
